meta.notes: Indicative baselines compiled from public aggregator reports and real-estate blogs (Housing.com/NoBroker/99acres-sourced summaries, Sobha, Squareyards, Casafy, etc.), not live listing data. For comparison/flagging use only, not a valuation. Villa/independent-house data was omitted for nearly all cities because no credible aggregate/average source could be found (only scattered individual listings existed, which were deliberately excluded per sourcing rules) — sale/rent figures below are apartment/flat baselines unless a villa block is explicitly present. Some BHK sizes are omitted at city or locality level where no sourced figure could be found; these gaps are intentional, not zeros. SECOND PASS (2026-07-29): Added villa/independent-house baselines for Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Gurgaon, Jaipur, Kochi, Kolkata, Noida, Surat, and Chandigarh (Mohali/Zirakpur) — aggregated from named builder/gated-community villa projects and locality-level villa-specific price data across multiple sources (see each city's sources array). Villa data intentionally omitted for Mumbai, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Indore, Nagpur, Lucknow where no credible multi-source villa/independent-house pricing could be found. Also added rent baselines for Indore (citywide + Vijay Nagar locality), Chandigarh (citywide 2BHK/3BHK), and additional Lucknow localities (Hazratganj, Indira Nagar, Alambagh) plus Gomti Nagar 3BHK.
